title: Kissed with Caramel Brown Irish Basmati Rice Bake
description: A cozy Irish dish featuring jammy, gooey caramelized brown basmati rice, macrobiotic-friendly. Cooked to perfection in a cedar-plank vessel.
instructions: Soak the cedar plank for at least 30 minutes.
Cook the basmati rice according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the carrots and parsnips, cooking until tender, about 10 minutes.
Mix in the molasses, maple syrup, cocoa powder, ginger, and cinnamon.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of cooked basmati rice.
Add a layer of the carrot-parsnip mixture on top of the rice.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of rice on top.
Place the cedar plank on a baking sheet and carefully transfer the rice mixture to the plank.
Cover the plank with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is caramelized.
